messages.english: Open evidence tools for your saved country.
Crop planner → Site country and region → Review country evidence
messages.translation: Umhleli wezitshalo → Izwe nesifunda sendawo → Hlola ubufakazi bezwe

messages.english: Use the country you saved for this site to open its existing evidence dossier. Countries without a dossier show general reference tools. Opening the link does not save country details, approve an agricultural region or enable local crop advice.
messages.translation: Sebenzisa izwe olilondolozele le ndawo ukuvula ifayela lalo lobufakazi elikhona. Amazwe angenalo ifayela lobufakazi abonisa amathuluzi ajwayelekile okubhekisela. Ukuvula isixhumanisi akuyilondolozi imininingwane yezwe, akugunyazi isifunda sezolimo futhi akuvuli izeluleko zokulima izitshalo kuleyo ndawo.
